subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace skill diagnostics ship as a new `skills lint` command only, or must normal `skills list`/`skills check`/Gateway/Web status also surface skipped SKILL.md candidates before #57091 closes?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the acceptable product surface is not: a lint command is a bounded repair, while the issue explicitly describes invisible skills in status and management APIs.

options.title: Land lint-first, track status follow-up
options.body: Use PR #92028 as the first repair after conflict/runtime-parity fixes, then keep or open a narrower follow-up for status/Web visibility.

options.title: Require status/list/check diagnostics now
options.body: Hold the candidate PR until skipped candidate diagnostics are threaded through normal status APIs and documented user flows.

options.title: Accept lint-only as complete
options.body: Close #57091 once a maintainer-approved lint command lands, treating management-surface consistency as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Land lint-first, track status follow-up
recommendation.body: Use PR #92028 as the first repair after conflict/runtime-parity fixes, then keep or open a narrower follow-up for status/Web visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skills loading/status work makes vincentkoc the best available owner for deciding the status versus lint boundary.
